core_question: How do I unshrink a wool sweater that came out too small in the wash? (secondary: How do I replace old guitar strings with new ones?)
answer_summary: Soak the sweater in lukewarm water with hair conditioner or baby shampoo to relax the fibers, gently stretch it back toward its original size, and lay it flat to dry, re-stretching as it dries.; after the topic shift: Loosen and remove the old strings, thread each new string through the bridge/tuning post, wind it while keeping tension, cut excess, then tune up to pitch and stretch/retune a few times.
